content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M. Pharm/ MS Pharm/ MSc or Equivalent with specialization in Natural Products/ Pharmacognosy/ Chemistry or equivalent with specialization in Pharmacy/ Life sciences/ Chemical Sciences with hands on experience in isolation and structure elucidation and semi-synthetic modifications of natural products; PG degree with 60% marks for GN/OBC (55% for SC/ST/PH) from UGC recognized University/ Institute, autonomous bodies NIPER/IITs/IISER; Qualified in at least one of DBT-BET, NET, GATE, or any other National-Level Examination conducted by Central Government Departments, Institutes, or their authorized agencies for recruitment of qualified manpower Experience: Hands on experience in isolation and structure elucidation and semi-synthetic modifications of natural products Other conditions: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification Desirable: Prior experience in performing column Chromatography, HPLC analysis, LC-MS and NMR data interpretation
